title: workplan_decision_response
description: Response schema for the workplan agent declaring the outcome of this turn.

decision.description: Use 'ask_question' when you posted one or more clarifying questions this turn - or confirmed that an equivalent question you posted earlier is still unresolved, in which case you stop without posting a duplicate - and are stopping without writing a plan. Use 'plan_ready' when you called update_work_item with the finished plan and announced it in a comment.
